when.$comment: Ministério da Saúde: geriatric diapers for people aged 60+ or with a disability.

when.$comment: MTE, 2026 calendar: base year 2024, average pay up to R$ 2.766, at least 30 days worked, PIS/Pasep for 5+ years. Value: minimum wage / 12 x months worked.
